**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 already delivers our preferred audit position in full:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, without unreasonable disruption (§ 22.1)
- **Conduct:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, in which case we pay reasonable costs plus the undisputed shortfall (§ 22.2)
- **System access:** expressly prohibited — Vendor and its auditor may not access our systems directly, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (§ 22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protection (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall resolves the audited quantity issue).

I also confirmed the planner's flag on Section 23: "RECORDS AND CUSTOMER ASSURANCE" is a heading only with no operative text, so it creates no broader records-inspection or verification right, and a document-wide search for audit/inspection/verification/records language surfaced nothing else binding us.
